description: This source file defines a command-line utility for establishing a connection to an OpenClaw gateway, parsing command-line arguments, managing connection options, performing a health check, and printing the connection status. It includes data structures for options and output, asynchronous operations for network requests, and utility functions for resolving endpoints, with logic specific to the 'Connect' command of the OpenClaw macOS CLI project.

classes.name: ConnectOptions
classes.description: A structure holding command-line options for establishing a connection, with a static method to parse arguments.

classes.name: ConnectOutput
classes.description: A structure representing the output status of the connection attempt, including connection details, snapshot, health, and error message.

classes.name: SnapshotStore
classes.description: An actor class for asynchronously storing and retrieving the latest HelloOk snapshot.

classes.name: GatewayEndpoint
classes.description: A data structure (assumed from context) representing gateway URL, token, password, and mode.

classes.name: GatewayConfig
classes.description: A configuration structure containing gateway-specific settings such as URL, token, port, mode, etc.

classes.name: GatewayChannelActor
classes.description: An actor class responsible for managing the network channel to the gateway, sending requests, and handling shutdown.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to populate ConnectOptions.

methods.name: printConnectOutput
methods.description: Prints the connection output details either in JSON or readable text format.

methods.name: resolveGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate gateway endpoint URL and credentials based on options and configuration.

methods.name: bestEffortEndpoint
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the endpoint, returning nil if it fails.

methods.name: gatewayEndpoint(fromRawURL:opts:mode:config:)
methods.description: Creates a GatewayEndpoint from a raw URL string, with options and mode.

methods.name: resolvedToken
methods.description: Resolves the authentication token based on options and config.

methods.name: resolvedPassword
methods.description: Resolves the password based on options and config.

methods.name: resolveLocalHost
methods.description: Determines the local host address for the gateway based on bind setting.

methods.name: runConnect
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that performs argument parsing, connection setup, health check, snapshot handling, and output printing.
